notes_for_editor: Brief record matches the sources on county, tower kind, status and coordinates; no correction proposed. Conflict left open: firelookout.com says destroyed 1960, while the Pastmaps description of a 1966 topographic map reprint (a seller's blurb, not the map itself) mentions a lookout tower on Teeters Peak in mid-1960s terrain. The seller does not date the tower, so the conflict holds only if the tower stood in the mid-1960s. The 1934 date, 50-foot height and 1960 destruction rest on one lookout-specific page. No staffing, fire, access, rental or site-today evidence in the sources read. The 50-foot height is converted to 15.2 m.
